name: Kouib Slide
author: kouider bounama

sections.description:
Kouib Slide is a professional, lightweight, and fast posts slider plugin for WordPress. It allows you to display your posts in beautiful, responsive sliders and carousels anywhere on your site using shortcodes. It features an independent control panel with extensive customization options.

Key Features:
* Multiple layout templates (Fullscreen, Split, Minimal).
* Various transition effects including 3D Coverflow, Flip, Cube, and more.
* Fully responsive with customizable breakpoints for Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop.
* Powerful shortcode builder integrated into the dashboard.
* Advanced typography and color controls.
* RTL fully supported.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/kouib-slide directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Kouib Slide’ screen in the admin menu to configure the plugin defaults.
  4. Generate a shortcode from the dashboard or manually use [kouib_slide] or [kouib_carousel] in your posts/pages.
sections.faq:
How do I use the shortcode?

You can use [kouib_slide] in any post, page, or widget that supports shortcodes. For a carousel, use [kouib_carousel].

Can I override the default settings in the shortcode?

Yes! You can use parameters to override the defaults. For example: [kouib_slide count="3" category="news" layout="split"].

Why is the 3D transition not smooth?

For circular loop transitions (like Coverflow, Cube, Flip) to work smoothly, it is highly recommended to have at least 3 posts with featured images available to display.
